The API converter in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` maps stored payload fields and generates snippets. The snippet helper lives in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` as `getMemoContentSnippet`.

`CreateMemoComment` triggers indirect recomputation through the `Memo` relation. `memopayload.RunOnce` performs a batch rebuild of all memos but is not wired into server startup; it only exists as a runner. value.text:
The full picture is now clear.

Derived metadata fields include `tags`, `property`, and `snippet`. `tags` and `property` are persisted in `MemoPayload` via `RebuildMemoPayload`. `snippet` is computed on-the-fly during API conversion and not stored. Core extraction happens in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`.

`RebuildMemoPayload` lives in `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`. Snippet generation is handled by `getMemoContentSnippet` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`.

Persisted metadata recomputes on `CreateMemo` and `UpdateMemo` when the content field is in the update mask. Snippets recompute on every API response conversion through `convertMemoFromStore`, `batchConvertMemoRelations`, `memo_relation_service`, and `user_service_notifications`.

`memopayload.RunOnce` exists for batch rebuilds but is not wired into server startup. Mentions extracted in Esed for notifications are not stored in the payload.
All necessary information has been gathered. I am now preparing the precise answer with exact file paths and function references.

Memos derives memo metadata from Markdown content on the **server**. The API exposes three output-only fields used for lists, filters, and previews: `tags`, `property`, and `snippet`. Tags and property are **persisted** in `MemoPayload`; snippet is **recomputed on read**.

---

## What is derived

Defined in the protos:

| Field | Stored? | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `tags` | Yes (`MemoPayload.tags`) | `#tag` tokens parsed from content |
| `property` | Yes (`MemoPayload.property`) | `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, `title` |
| `snippet` | No | Plain-text preview (max 64 chars) |

```14:22:/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto
  // The calculated properties from the memo content.
  message Property {
    bool has_link = 1;
    bool has_task_list = 2;
    bool has_code = 3;
    bool has_incomplete_tasks = 4;
    // The title extracted from the first H1 heading, if present.
    string title = 5;
  }
```

```240:266:/bench/repo/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto
  // Output only. The tags extracted from the content.
  repeated string tags = 10 [(google.api.field_behavior) = OUTPUT_ONLY];
  ...
  // Output only. The computed properties of the memo.
  Property property = 15 [(google.api.field_behavior) = OUTPUT_ONLY];
  ...
  // Output only. The snippet of the memo content. Plain text only.
  string snippet = 17 [(google.api.field_behavior) = OUTPUT_ONLY];
```

---

## Where it is computed

### 1. Core extraction — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`

`markdown.NewService(...)` (with tag + mention extensions) is created in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go`.

**`ExtractAll`** (used for persistence) walks the goldmark AST once and extracts:

- **Tags**: `*mast.TagNode` nodes (skips tags inside links/images)
- **Property flags**:
  - `has_link` — any `KindLink` node
  - `has_code` — `CodeBlock`, `FencedCodeBlock`, or `CodeSpan`
  - `has_task_list` / `has_incomplete_tasks` — GFM `TaskCheckBox` nodes (incomplete if unchecked)
  - `title` — plain text of the **first block-level child** of the document if it is an H1
- **Mentions** (`@user`) — extracted but **not** stored in payload (used for notifications only)

```355:421:/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go
func (s *service) ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error) {
	...
		if tagNode, ok := asMemoTagNode(n); ok {
			data.Tags = append(data.Tags, string(tagNode.Tag))
		}
		if mentionNode, ok := n.(*mast.MentionNode); ok {
			data.Mentions = append(data.Mentions, strings.ToLower(string(mentionNode.Username)))
		}
		// Check if the first block-level child of the document is an H1 heading.
		...
		switch n.Kind() {
		case gast.KindLink:
			data.Property.HasLink = true
		case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock, gast.KindCodeSpan:
			data.Property.HasCode = true
		case east.KindTaskCheckBox:
			data.Property.HasTaskList = true
			if checkBox, ok := n.(*east.TaskCheckBox); ok {
				if !checkBox.IsChecked {
					data.Property.HasIncompleteTasks = true
				}
			}
		}
	...
	data.Tags = uniquePreserveCase(data.Tags)
```

Tag syntax is parsed by `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/parser/tag.go` (`#tag`, not `##` headings).

**`GenerateSnippet`** (used for previews) strips code blocks, walks text/auto-links/tags, joins block elements with spaces, truncates at 64 runes on a word boundary:

```263:345:/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go
func (s *service) GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error) {
	...
		case *gast.Text:
			...
		case *gast.AutoLink:
			buf.Write(node.URL(content))
		case *mast.TagNode:
			buf.WriteByte('#')
			buf.Write(node.Tag)
	...
	if len(snippet) > maxLength {
		snippet = truncateAtWord(snippet, maxLength)
	}
```

### 2. Payload persistence — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`

`RebuildMemoPayload` calls `ExtractAll` and writes only `Tags` + `Property` into `memo.Payload`:

```74:87:/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	...
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```

### 3. API response mapping — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`

On every memo conversion, stored payload fields are mapped and snippet is generated fresh:

```47:80:/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go
	if memo.Payload != nil {
		memoMessage.Tags = memo.Payload.Tags
		memoMessage.Property = convertMemoPropertyFromStore(memo.Payload.Property)
		...
	}
	...
	snippet, err := s.getMemoContentSnippet(memo.Content)
	...
	memoMessage.Snippet = snippet
```

Snippet helper in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`:

```83:89:/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go
func (s *APIV1Service) getMemoContentSnippet(content string) (string, error) {
	snippet, err := s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)
```

Snippet is also generated for related memos in `batchConvertMemoRelations`, `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go`, and `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go`.

---

## What triggers recomputation

### Persisted metadata (`tags`, `property`)

| Operation | File | Function | Trigger |
|---|---|---|---|
| **CreateMemo** | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `CreateMemo` | Always, before `Store.CreateMemo` |
| **UpdateMemo** | same | `UpdateMemo` | Only when `update_mask` includes `"content"` |
| **CreateMemoComment** | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` | `CreateMemoComment` | Indirectly — calls `CreateMemo` internally |

Evidence for create:

```108:110:/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
	if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
	}
```

Evidence for content update:

```436:451:/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
		if path == "content" {
			contentUpdated = true
			...
			memo.Content = request.Memo.Content
			if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
			}
			update.Content = &memo.Content
			update.Payload = memo.Payload
```

Comment path:

```56:59:/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go
	memoComment, err := s.CreateMemo(withSuppressMentionNotifications(withSuppressSSE(ctx)), &v1pb.CreateMemoRequest{
		Memo:   comment,
		MemoId: request.CommentId,
	})
```

**Not triggered** by: visibility/pinned/state/timestamp updates, attachment/relation changes, reactions, or deletes.

**Batch rebuild**: `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` in `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` can rebuild all memos, but it is **not registered** in `/bench/repo/server/server.go` (only `s3presign.RunOnce` is started). It exists as a utility, not a live server path.

### Snippet (read-time)

Recomputed whenever a memo is converted to API form — e.g. `GetMemo`, `ListMemos`, relation/notification endpoints — via `getMemoContentSnippet` → `GenerateSnippet(..., 64)`. No write-path trigger.

### Mentions (ephemeral, not payload)

`ExtractAll` is also called from `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go` → `resolveMentionTargets` to drive inbox notifications on create/update/comment; mentions are **not** stored in `MemoPayload`.

---

## How lists/previews consume it

- **Filtering** (`has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, `tags`) uses the **persisted** payload via CEL filters built in `/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoFilters.ts` (e.g. `has_link`, `has_task_list`).
- **Previews** use server-computed `snippet` in components like `MemoCommentListView`, `RelationCard`, `UserMemoMap`.
- **Frontend does not re-derive** tags/property/snippet; it consumes API output-only fields.

---

## Summary

| Metadata | Computed in | Persisted? | Recomputed when |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tags` | `markdown.ExtractAll` | Yes (`MemoPayload`) | CreateMemo; UpdateMemo with `content` mask |
| `property.*` | `markdown.ExtractAll` | Yes | Same |
| `snippet` | `markdown.GenerateSnippet` | No | Every API read/conversion |
| `@mentions` | `markdown.ExtractAll` | No | Used for notifications only |

h14.

`internal/markdown/markdown.go` (`ExtractAll`, persisted via `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`); memo creation and content updates (including comment creation through memo creation), plus snippet generation on API conversion/read; tags, link/code/task-list flags (including incomplete tasks), first-H1 title, and a 64-character plain-text snippet.
